dog.description_text:
Lila Grace came to us from Mississippi searching for the fresh start she so deeply deserves. This beautiful girl has a soft, loving personality and a heart full of affection. She may have come from uncertain circumstances, but she is ready to leave the past behind and begin a new chapter filled with comfort, safety, and love. Lila Grace would thrive in a home where she can finally feel secure and cherished every single day.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
